      • createTime

        @NameInMap(value="CreateTime")
public String createTime

        The creation time of the file system. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard. Example: 2022-04-18T06:03:15.836222Z.

        example:

        2022-04-18T06:03:15.836222Z

      • description

        @NameInMap(value="Description")
public String description

        The description of the file system.

        example:

        This is the first Apsara File Storage for HDFS instance of my company

      • fileSystemId

        @NameInMap(value="FileSystemId")
public String fileSystemId

        The ID of the file system.

        example:

        37af8f42-2abc-4e74-889d-664f5163****

      • fileSystemName

        @NameInMap(value="FileSystemName")
public String fileSystemName

        The name of the file system.

        example:

        MyFirstHDFS

      • meteringMode

        @NameInMap(value="MeteringMode")
public String meteringMode

        The billing method of the file system.

        example:

        UsageBased,CapacityBased

      • meteringSpaceSize

        @NameInMap(value="MeteringSpaceSize")
public Float meteringSpaceSize

        The billable capacity of the file system. Unit: bytes. Billable capacity = MAX [(Number of files + Number of directories) × 5 MiB, Used capacity]. This is statistical data and is for reference only, and is not used for billing. Apsara File Storage for HDFS is billed based on the peak billable capacity of the previous hour. For more detailed metering data, see View billing details.

        example:

        107374182400

      • mountPointCount

        @NameInMap(value="MountPointCount")
public Long mountPointCount

        The number of mount points.

        example:

        2

      • numberOfDirectories

        @NameInMap(value="NumberOfDirectories")
public Long numberOfDirectories

        The number of directories.

        example:

        100

      • numberOfFiles

        @NameInMap(value="NumberOfFiles")
public Long numberOfFiles

        The number of files.

        example:

        1000

      • protocolType

        @NameInMap(value="ProtocolType")
public String protocolType

        The protocol type. Only Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) is supported.

        example:

        HDFS

      • provisionedThroughputInMiBps

        @NameInMap(value="ProvisionedThroughputInMiBps")
public Long provisionedThroughputInMiBps

        The provisioned throughput. Unit: MB/s.

public String regionId
